events.text: GM posted a link.
GM stated the professor had a massive impact on character's life.
Redecter asked if this was starfinder.
Redecter asked for the books.
Antoine stated everything needed was on the SF2E AON.
GM stated the party were crew on a ship.
Oscar said he wanted to be a bounty hunter.
Oscar asked how many bounties were on the ship.
Ryo guessed Oscar wondered if crew had bounties on them.
Chua said bounties were just one way of making money.
GM stated the party was aboard the ship.
An alert popped up on screen.
Arctus pressed the screen.
The ship shook from a laser cannon blast.
Arctus tried to hail the attacking pirates.
All passed out.
Holis checked the ship for missing items.
Woke up restrained together in the brig.
A portal opened with green and blue flame.
The corpse of a cat-man came out of the portal.
A distant alarm from the brig sensors was heard.
The door slid up revealing an automaton cleaner.
Joo-Dee attempted to scoot through the open door.
Automaton cleaner rolled toward Bones's corpse and began cleaning.
Cleaning bot short-circuited and beeped near the corpse.
Taller cleaning robot with keycards stepped through the brig door.
Cleaning robot whispered the red substance was interrupted transmutation.
Cleaning robot freed the party and returned their gear.
Combat against Dekker started with the players going first.
Dekker died from Damon's shot and the corpse was torn apart.
Arctus estimated fewer than ten pirates remained on board.
Oofy explained they were in room 1 and described the ship layout.
Arktos confirmed the corpse was caught mid-transmutation into an ooze.
The party looted weapons, armor, grenades and a communicator.
Joo-Dee opened the cell doors and freed Chik and Kae-Vo.
Ooofy perked up and asked to be interviewed.
Ooofy asked Holis about sponsorship.
Ooofy sent a long-range distress call.
A hostile ship hit The Stargazer.
Four pirates burst into the rec room and demanded passage to the pods.
Damon blasted the head off a Nova Pirate.
Combat ended with the pirates dead.
Oofy reported the floor was clear and suggested looking around or going upstairs.
The party entered the medical bay.
The party found a medkit, medpatches and a bone serum in the cabinets.
Joo-Dee examined Damon and found no trace of slime.
Joo-Dee started leading the group toward the Ammo Room.
The party entered the ammo room full of starship-grade munitions.
The party saw battery charging stations in the room.
The group decided to move to the control room next.
The party passed through the cargo bay and collected an autograppler, cable, ammunition and batteries.
The party entered the control room overlooking the aft.
Oofy reported a ship missile got stuck from the bone ship attacks.
Oofy said someone could unjam the missile from the promenade deck.
The party found a rare life-sized plushie in the cabinet.
The party confirmed lower rooms were explored except the reactor.
The party entered the reactor room.
The Symposium fixed and stabilised the reactor.
The reactor released a last burst of unstable energy.
The Symposium took a small zap from the reactor.
Joo-Dee treated Kae-Vo with medicine and restored health.
Chik urged heading upstairs to secure the ship.
The party went upstairs.
The party arrived in the western upper hallway.
Oofy described the missile launcher to the west and the central room to the east.
Hinata Hoshibi introduced herself and offered to join forces.
Joo-Dee introduced the party members to Hinata.
Arktos headed through the magnetic field to tinker with the missiles.
Hinata asked about the group's capabilities and tactics.
Joo-Dee said a high frequency sound wave knocked the crew out.
Oofy said repairing the jammed missile launcher on the bridgeway would take a few minutes.
Oofy stated the repair required DC 15 Acrobatics or Athletics and DC 15 Crafting.
Oofy asked Hinata who she was and how she got onto the ship.
Oofy opened the door to the bridge at a terminal.
The party made their way over to attempt the repair.
Arktos kept balance on the damaged bridgeway and held the edge.
Arktos unjammed the missile launcher and made their way back inside.
Oofy congratulated Arktos after coming back inside.
Oofy said a scream knocked the crew unconscious.
The party agreed to move to the next room.
Hinata said she woke on the ship after the scream and confirmed she was Solarian.
The party entered ROOM 1 with large storage crates.
Polly demanded why the cursed prisoners were out of their cages.
A blast from the undead ship hit the Stargazer and ripped a hole in the ceiling.
The darkness formed into a nightmarish lovecraftian entity.
Arktos learned the sinkwell was immune to traditional damage and needed 3 successes to disperse.
Arktos relayed the sinkwell's capabilities to the rest of the party.
Chik attempted Occultism checks against the Sinkwell.
Damon moved into range and attempted Thievery checks against the Sinkwell.
Hinata was grabbed by the Sinkwell.
Damon disabled the Spiritual Sinkwell and ended combat.
A Diplomacy check to befriend Polly succeeded.
Polly said she did not want to die there and suggested allying for safety.
Polly recharged all of the party's batteries for free.
Oofy warned the captain was no more than 2 rooms away and to get ready for a fight to the death.
Laetheron said he would like to continue but did not know how many people were still here.
GM paused the campaign to recruit and said the Stargazer sat exactly where it was.
Bruce said he had been busy and was still a week out.
A far greater swell of power rose after the spiritual sinkwell was destroyed.
Arktos established their warp and scanned the area for anomalies.
Oofy reported the pirates had retreated from the living room to the bridge.
The Stargazer shook from necro plasma cannon blasts.
Polly stowed away below deck.
Arktos floated off with LUKA.
The party went into the next room and found the big open plan kitchen rearranged.
A large glass cube with grey figures stood where the table had been.
The ghost people in the prison became solid and looked like the crew companions.
Arktos tinkered with the cube and deactivated the prison.
The cube opened and the prisoners walked free.
Bella started jamming a knife into the bridge door to force it open.
The kitchen door opens.
The party sees Captain Vex Ashburn on the bridge.
Captain Vex Ashburn orders the nova pirates to attack and combat begins.
Zels stabs Captain Vex Ashburn with a main-gauche and slashes her with a phase cutlass.
Arktos blasts Captain Vex Ashburn to 1 HP and she falls to her knees.
Bella hurls her kusarigama and slams the pirate helmsman Ovvat to the floor non-lethally.
The ship locks onto its destination and blasts off toward Aballon.
Arktos hands the piloting to Zels and the party rushes across the ship making quick repairs.
Arktos applies quick fixes to the wiring, gears and pistons in the walls.
The ship enters the drift.
The party awakens above Aballon, above the metal city.
Laetheron suggests running a scan to check for pursuit.
Oofy voices doubt about whether the pirate ship was destroyed or escaped.
The scan shows the city on the screen.
Bella asks whether the city is mostly normal and whether they need to stay on guard.
Oofy says the city is mostly normal, safer than most cities, with Anacite protectors patrolling and cameras everywhere.
Oofy gives three tips: avoid the rooftops at fullbright, stay near the air pumps, and do not leave the city.
Laetheron calls the city an interesting one.
Laetheron suggests they get going, since they have a meeting to attend.
Bella agrees and says they should go.
Oofy stops at the bridge viewing glass, emits a low tone, and the Stargazer's screens flicker with it before he says something has been installed and changed in him.
Oofy says something has passed through him, that he knows things he did not before, that The Scream left something in him, and that he wants to join the crew.
Oofy says he does not need an answer yet, that the meeting will not wait, and offers to lead the way.
Bella says she does not know what or who is Screaming, and agrees to go to the meeting.
Laetheron says they always appreciate another helping hand and mind.
Laetheron says the Professor has been kept waiting long enough and suggests talking more on the way.
